requirements.text: Phone including AI voice, AI chat, live chat, and email on one platform using one Agency-controlled knowledge base; email native rather than a disconnected inbox.
Unified constituent record covering calls, chats, emails, and form submissions.
Live record-level Agency system data may inform all channels; account-specific disclosure only after Agency-approved identity confirmation.
Voice agent can send SMS/equivalent links and vendor identifies required telephony or messaging registrations.
Phone inquiry can continue over email in the same case.
Voice interactions create tracked cases with transcription and AI-generated summary.
Automatic caller-language detection/response; proposal lists supported languages and fallback behavior.
Live-chat escalation with full context, availability-aware queue, off-hours fallback, and chat-to-email case continuity.
Public chatbot conforms to WCAG 2.1 AA; current VPAT or equivalent accessibility conformance report submitted.
AI-native email/case management includes approved standardized language preference, source-record linking, original-requester handling, AI labels/assignment, and internal notes/mentions.
Send on behalf of Agency domain and generate SPF/DKIM/DMARC DNS records for Agency publication.
Read integration with CAMA/equivalent for parcel, ownership, valuation, exemption, application, and protest/appeal data.
Integration under Vendor contractual control/support; partner/subcontractor named with clear responsibility split.
Integration supports systems without modern public APIs via approved read-only patterns such as exports, replicas, or secure file exchange.
Working Agency-content system for staff review within ten business days of kickoff on at least two channels.
Structured staff validation against historical inquiries before public launch; Agency sign-off required.
At least five completed projects in last seven years involving high-volume public inquiries for government/similarly regulated public-service clients.
At least one successful production CAMA/property-assessment/tax/permitting/equivalent system-of-record integration into AI-powered or multichannel communications; comparable references.
Named implementation lead with prior similar government/regulated deployment experience, expected through go-live and stabilization.
Concise experience matrix with jurisdiction, approximate dates, scope, channels, and system-of-record integration flag.
Insurance letter of intent from insurer authorized in Arkansas and required proof of insurance.
All software support/data access/sharing/integrations/transfers/disclosures require County IT review and prior written approval before execution.

Complete pricing for 50,000 annual voice interactions, CAMA integration, 15 licenses, implementation/configuration/KB/on-site training, overage, extra licenses, SMS, all-in first year, optional multiyear.
County forms signed by authorized representative with legal authority to bind bidder.
All County addenda acknowledged.
For contract/purchase order at or above $1,000, written Arkansas boycott-of-Israel certification is required.
